description: Manages user profiles, personal information, and preferences within the system.

endpoints.name: UpdateProfile
endpoints.description: Updates the current user's basic profile information.

profile.description: Updated profile model containing new information

example_uses: Update my email address to new.email@example.com.
Change my first name to John and last name to Doe.
I need to update my profile with new contact details.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify basic profile details such as email, first name, and last name for the currently authenticated user.

endpoints.name: UpdateUserInfo
endpoints.description: Updates current user's comprehensive information and profile settings.
example_uses: Update my organizational unit and duty station.
Set my preferred language and theme in my user preferences.
I want to update my supervisor ID and position details.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to update comprehensive user information, including personal details, organizational unit, and user preferences.

endpoints.name: GetUserProfileDetails
endpoints.description: Retrieves comprehensive current user information including profile, roles, permissions, organizational settings, and user preferences. Supports both authenticated user lookup and explicit email parameter for administrative purposes.

email.description: Optional specific email to get user info for (if not provided, uses current authenticated user)

example_uses: Get my current user profile details.
Retrieve the profile information for user@example.com.
Show me all the details about my account, including preferences and organizational context.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the complete profile and settings for the current user, or for a specific user by email if you have administrative privileges.
